description: This file defines TypeScript types and a function to map various input shapes into a standardized PersonaDraft format for a persona management system. It includes type definitions for PersonaDraft and AttachedDraftPersonaInput, and a function mapToPersonaDraft that converts input data into a PersonaDraft object, handling different input shapes and extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: mapToPersonaDraft
methods.description: Converts various input shapes into a standardized PersonaDraft object, handling both backend schema and attached draft persona JSON formats.
